title: Social Media Ads Evaluator (Native Portuguese Speaker)
why_it_fits: Content Specialist match. 3 skills: excel, word, social media. Likely PH eligibility signal
why_it_might_not: Confirm Philippines eligibility before applying. Salary not disclosed
position_overview: Job Description: We are seeking a native Portuguese speaker residing in Brazil to join the Appen Community as a Social Media Ads Evaluator. In this Independent Contractor role, you will evaluate the relevance, appropriateness, and accuracy of social media advertisements, contributing valuable insights to improve online advertising strategies. Key Responsibilities: Evaluate the relevance and appropriateness of social media ads by assessing their usefulness and accuracy. Utilize an external platform to rate ads and identify any misleading content. Gain insights into people's preferences regarding online advertisements and understand the reasons behind their preferences. Share your perspective on ads within the platform. Engage daily by logging into the designated social media site to assess and rate a batch of ads aligned with your unique interests. Commit to spending one hour daily, five days a week, evaluating ads exclusively on a personal computer (desktop/laptop). Demonstrate a willingness to view and evaluate potentially offensive content. Requirements: Native Portuguese speaker residing in Brazil. Access to a personal computer (desktop/laptop) and a stable internet connection. Strong attention to detail and analytical skills. Ability to commit to one hour of work daily, five days a week. Willingness to view and evaluate potentially offensive content. Excellent communication skills. If you are ready to embark on this fantastic opportunity to earn from the comfort of your own home at your convenience, we encourage you to apply today! Please note that due to the nature of this opportunity, only candidates residing in Brazil and who are native Portuguese speakers will be considered. If you are successful in your application, you will be sent an email to set up and finalize an account set up on Appen Connect, your gateway into this project. Once you have reset your password, you will be registered to the project which can be found in your 'Applied' tab. From here you can complete the required qualification steps in preparation for onboarding and your first earnings. This role is a project-based opportunity with CrowdGen, where you will join as an Independent Contractor. If selected, you'll receive an email from CrowdGen to create your account, reset your password, complete the setup, and proceed with your application. #crowdgen Originally posted on Himalayas
